description: Turns a MIDI clock into a voltage that rises over 64 beats and starts again

params.text: Sets the tempo the count runs at between clock pulses, 0 to 240 beats per minute
Sets how many clock pulses make one beat, a whole number from 1 to 16

inputs.text: Advances the count on each rising edge above 2V, reading low again below 0.1V, and is ignored while the module is stopped
Sets the count back to the start and starts it running, on each rising edge above 2V
Stops the count on each rising edge above 2V, leaving the output where it stood
Starts the count running again from where it stopped, on each rising edge above 2V

outputs.text: A voltage rising from 0V to 10V over 64 beats and dropping back, moving between clock pulses at the tempo the BPM knob sets

notes: the module comes up stopped and the clock is ignored until a rising edge reaches STRT or CONT
this module reads only the first channel of any cable patched to it and sends one channel out

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
